title: Blistered cherry tomatoes with beans and eggs

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Everything is a plain kitchen staple: tomatoes, garlic, tinned beans, eggs, bread, oil and basil.

supermarket.reason: Every ingredient is an everyday item at any mainstream supermarket.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a lidded frying pan and a toaster, and the technique is simple.

works.reason: 500g tomatoes, a tin of beans, four eggs and four slices of toast make a sensible breakfast for four, and the timings set the whites while the tomatoes burst into enough juice to simmer the beans.

honest_times.reason: Ten minutes covers slicing the garlic, draining the beans and making toast, and the step timings add up to about 15 minutes.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning is used, the names match their ids, and nothing unlisted appears.

seasonal_feel.reason: Blistered cherry tomatoes are the heart of the dish and suit a July morning.

plain_voice.reason: Short, clear British English steps that a beginner could follow.

hearty_healthy.reason: Eggs, beans, tomatoes and wholemeal toast make a filling, balanced breakfast a family would happily eat again.
